name: Bingo Hall
hook: Eyes down! Daub fast, shout BINGO first.
how: The caller draws a ball every few seconds: tap it on your card to daub it. Finish a line, then the four corners, then a full house, and hit BINGO before anyone else.
controls: Click or tap numbers to daub, click or tap BINGO (or press B)
uses: Prizes won, all time, shown on the results card.
Bots take the empty seats, daub at a human pace and sometimes win.
The host's browser calls the balls and checks every BINGO; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone sees the same balls, cards and who is close to a bingo.
ideas: Make it a spooky Halloween bingo with pumpkin daubers
Add an X-shaped prize after the four corners
Give each player two cards to play at once
